name: i18n-string-field
title: i18n String Field
description: Translation field that compares the text with its source: dropped or renamed placeholders ({count}, %s, {{name}}, …), unclosed tags, ICU plural forms the target language needs per CLDR, rendered length against a UI budget, and untranslated pastes. One-tap fixes.

meta.summary: Checks each translation against its source as it is typed, so dropped placeholders, broken tags or missing plural forms don't ship.
catches: Markup tags missing or left unclosed
ICU plural branches the target language needs (via Intl.PluralRules)
Translation longer than the UI budget
limits: Plural rules come from the browser's Intl.PluralRules data, which can lag CLDR
Rendered length is a character estimate, not measured pixel width
Doesn't judge translation quality or meaning
a11y: Visible label tied to the field, described by the issues list
Issues list is a polite live region
Placeholder chips have aria-labels saying present or missing
Keep-same button has an aria-label and title
